My dear [Mrs Buston](/person/236)
We shall be very glad to see you and [Miss Dampier](/person/404) at 3 o’clock on Wednesday - I shall have to leave you at 4, as it is the day of the [G F S](/organisation/23) quarterly meeting, when the girls pay in their money - and I read to them[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Anne Mary Buston (1824/5-1895) was the wife of the Rev.

Roger Buston (1807/8-mid 1880s), Vicar of Twyford, and mother of a numerous family.
[^2]: The Girls\' Friendly Society was founded in 1875.
